Welcome ToPirates CoveSince 1957, nestled on the shores of Josephine, Alabama, Pirates Cove has been a beloved gathering place for locals, boaters, and beach lovers for decades. Known for it’s laid back atmosphere, legendary bushwackers and iconic cheeseburgers. Pirates Cove has a rich history of good times and community spirit. From its early days as a quiet waterfront hideaway to surviving hurricanes and changing times, Pirates Cove has remained a true gulf coast icon. A place where stories are made, friends become family and the sunsets never get old. Whether you’ve been coming here since the beginning or just discovered this hidden gem, one thing is for sure Pirates Cove is more than a bar, its a way of life

Live Music & Events Coming Up 
Something fun’s always just around the corner, live music on the deck, special events, and a few surprises. Come hang out with us!
